summary: Tested admin live features: live edit, kick, ban/unban, broadcast, activity stats. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass over a real WSS client on throwaway accounts (test_admin_live.py). Covered: 401 guards (no token and player token), last_login/play_seconds/ban fields, 403 ban message on login, banned JWT gets 401 on /api/characters and WS closes 4401, unban works, expired ban stops blocking, permanent ban text, days validation (422) and 404, live edit sends 'me' with level/gold, hp==max_hp, mp==max_mp, +3 attr/+3 skill per level, plus the sys msg, kick closes 4002 with/without a reason, ban kicks online chars (4002 + ban text), offline kick returns 400, periodic play time save (~20s) on char and account, broadcast sends announce + [Announcement] chat (only our char was online). Admin UI (Playwright, while a throwaway char was held online over WS): last login and play time in header, Played column, Kick visible and Delete disabled for online char, live Save (WS got level 4/gold 999 and +9/+9 points), broadcast success message, kick via prompt, ban via confirm then banned tag, status and Unban, unban. One bug found: kick/ban with a long non-ASCII reason never closes the socket. All throwaway data cleaned up (89 accounts, same as before).

critical.issue: Game.kick cuts the close reason by characters (reason[:110]), but a WebSocket close reason must be <=123 bytes UTF-8. A non-ASCII reason (repro: kick with text 'é'*100) makes ws.close() raise. The exception is swallowed, so the client socket is NEVER closed: the player is removed from the world (online=false) and the API returns 200, but the client gets no 4002 and sits on a dead connection. Ban reasons with accents or Cyrillic hit the same path.

minor.issue: Empty body {} on an online char returns 200 and still sends 'An admin has adjusted your character.'. The offline path returns 400 'Nothing to update'. These two paths are inconsistent.
Lowering the level does not remove attr/skill points, so raising, lowering and raising again grants extra points with each cycle (online and offline).
Play time keeps growing during the link-dead window after a disconnect, because play_mark keeps running until remove_player.

issues: admin-message uses the red .form-err style for success messages too (Saved, Broadcast sent, Kicked, Unbanned); give success messages a neutral or green style
Ban reason input is too narrow: placeholder cut off at 'Reason (optional, shown to pl'
Play time shows '0m' for sessions under 1 minute; consider showing seconds or '<1m'

action_items: HIGH: In Game.kick, truncate the close reason by UTF-8 bytes, e.g. reason.encode()[:123].decode('utf-8','ignore'), and make sure the ws is still closed if close with a reason fails (fallback: ws.close(code=4002) with no reason). Retest with test_admin_kick_edge.py
Make the online live-edit path return 400 when level and gold are both None
Optional: take back attr/skill points on level decrease, or clamp them
UI: success style for admin-message, wider ban reason input
critical_code_review_comments: game.kick swallows every close exception silently, which hides the byte-length bug above
No cooldown after a kick: a kicked (not banned) player can reconnect right away. This is acceptable, but worth knowing
The ban check in login runs after the password check (good: no account enumeration). user_from_token checks the ban on every request (good)
seed_data_creation: Only throwaway admintest_*@test.io accounts with Tst* characters; all unbanned and deleted at the end (account count back to 89).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_admin_live.py runs with xdist (pytest.ini addopts); the module fixture cleans up its own accounts. test_admin_kick_edge.py reproduces the unicode kick bug: run with -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. hold_online.py <secs> keeps a throwaway char online over WS and writes ids to /tmp/hold.json and messages to /tmp/hold_msgs.log, for UI tests of online-only controls. Delete that account afterwards. The broadcast test skips unless online==1.
rca of the issue: Repro: connect a WS for a throwaway char, then POST /admin/characters/{cid}/kick {text:'é'*100}. The server builds 'You were kicked by an admin. Reason: ééé…', cuts it to 110 chars (~191 bytes), and ws.close(code=4002, reason=…) throws because the reason is over 123 bytes. The except: pass swallows it, then remove_player runs. Result: the client gets no close frame, the char is removed from game.players, and the socket stays open. Fix: cut the reason by bytes, and fall back to closing with no reason.
